start.headline: A parent asks about your school at 9:47 PM.
start.body: Your office closed hours ago. Here's what Banner Connect does next, without anyone on your staff lifting a finger.

steps.alt: Banner Christian School's Request Info Packet form, filled in by Sarah Ramirez for 2nd grade
steps.title: A parent reaches out after hours
steps.body: Sarah is on your website after her kids are in bed. She asks about 2nd grade for her son, Mateo, and how admissions works.

steps.alt: The first nurture email: subject line with the school's name and a thank-you note with a link to the info packet
steps.title: Her info packet arrives right away
steps.body: The first email goes out the moment she submits. Your school's name and her first name fill in on their own, so it reads like it came from your office.

steps.alt: The Inquiry to Enrollment pipeline with the Ramirez Family in the New Inquiry column
steps.title: She lands in your enrollment pipeline
steps.body: Every family who reaches out shows up in New Inquiry, with where they found you and how long since anyone talked to them.

steps.alt: The dashboard task list with follow-up calls assigned to the admissions director
steps.title: Your team knows who to call
steps.body: Follow-ups land on your admissions director's task list. Anything past due turns red, so no family slips through the cracks.

steps.alt: The Request Info Packet workflow: form trigger, create opportunity, add tag, then three emails with waits between them
steps.title: One workflow does all of it
steps.body: Behind the scenes, one automation creates the pipeline card, tags the family, and sends three emails over ten days. Banner 61 sets it up for you.

finish.headline: One inquiry, handled while your office was closed.
finish.body: Every family hears back right away, and your team always knows the next step.
